scope: Review intake and bounded component evidence. No replacement publication, hosted qualification or merge.

requirements.title: Supervisor accepts Darwin credentials with authority-granting ACLs
requirements.origin: Introduced. Both loaders are new relative to main 2b1d467e17; the mode/owner gate is blamed to 255f1ee8da8, on the environment loader introduced by 6d09eeb2453.
requirements.fix: Apply the existing Darwin descriptor ACL authority check to both loaders before accepting bytes or descriptors. Inspection errors and allow/unknown authority must refuse. Preserve genuine Linux systemd handling and deny-only ACL acceptance; add native tests at the actual loaders.

requirements.title: Durable API Protect discards the configured shared budget authority
requirements.origin: Introduced by the sidecar durable caller-execution composition in e44ce720cbb; approval-specific selection later changed in 11485c4ef67. Base retained the configured kernel budget handle.
requirements.fix: Refuse incompatible external budget configuration before provisioning, or explicitly select one composite authority for probes, admission and settlement. Preserving old shared usage requires a qualified state transition; do not silently reset, copy or replace accounting.

requirements.title: Valid keyring-backed trust service configurations always fail startup
requirements.origin: Introduced by b39b131271e keyring composition and seed stripping, interacting with pre-existing cluster/config revalidation.
requirements.fix: Keep direct seed access removed. Separate bootstrap custody validation from runtime configuration/token validation, and use the latter for cluster composition and request authentication. Exercise full healthy keyring startup, not just isolated constructors.

requirements.title: Cage admission buffers an entire directory before enforcing its scan limit
requirements.origin: Introduced in new linux.rs by 3d3e4b4d9d2. Later F012 repair reuses this enumerator.
requirements.fix: Pass a remaining entry/byte budget into the shared enumerator and refuse before pushing beyond it. Count skipped entries and bound the aggregate walk before sorting.

requirements.title: Temporal rule expansion is exponential before its candidate cap runs
requirements.origin: Introduced by 6ea79bb5dab in the new correlator; later indexing/conversion edits do not move the cap.
requirements.fix: Enforce the partial-candidate budget on each unique insertion and before intermediate-vector growth. Suppress/refuse immediately on exhaustion. Add a combined branching-plus-reuse control.

requirements.title: Identical uncovered tool calls execute repeatedly for one throttle unit
requirements.origin: Introduced by 9e9b3be5f61 and the new session-throttle store/guard contract.
requirements.fix: Use a kernel-owned dispatch-attempt identity. Permit free replay only for an authenticated retained operation whose execution cannot repeat; otherwise consume again or deny.

requirements.title: Dropping a timed-out blocking adapter leaves its queued invocation runnable
requirements.origin: Adapter file is new; the context-aware invoke path is attributed to 631edf1b208. The outer dispatch abort guard predates this PR.
requirements.fix: Give the adapter ownership of an abort-on-drop guard for each nested queued handoff. Avoid nested pool self-starvation using the existing dispatch boundary. Preserve the distinction between cancelling queued work and reconciling work that already started.

requirements.title: Unbounded broker DNS blocks control work and can hold global secret custody
requirements.origin: Introduced in the new broker resolver/preparation implementation by 38d8cd43412.
requirements.fix: Include DNS in one enforceable end-to-end preparation deadline and resolve outside the custody mutex. Avoid a second unconstrained lookup while retaining checked destination pinning. A timeout around an uncancellable worker alone does not bound retained work.

requirements.title: Hermes guest can exhaust its privileged model relay before admission
requirements.origin: Introduced by aa8d006f7ac in the new relay; later Responses-mode work preserves these paths.
requirements.fix: Bound connections before spawning handlers, enforce body deadlines, and bound retained event count/bytes including refusals. Refuse further traffic when evidence capacity is exhausted; do not silently truncate and claim complete capture.

requirements.title: Abandoned prepared broker connections retain secret entries and capacity
requirements.origin: Introduced in the new preparation map (38d8cd43412); prepared transport cleanup is attributed to 9ef512d0ba0.
requirements.fix: Bind transport abandonment to the exact retained operation and reconcile/sweep expired pre-capture entries. Preserve captured/later operation ownership and accounting; unconditional EOF deletion/refund is unsafe.

requirements.title: Runtime JSON stores can successfully write a file they refuse to reopen
requirements.origin: New reader/writer mismatch introduced by a76864ad1a6: bounded readers replace permissive base readers while existing writers remain unbounded.
requirements.fix: Use one backend size constant, serialize an isolated candidate including its newline, refuse before publishing oversized bytes, and publish live state only after successful persistence.

requirements.title: Cage artifact opening can block on a FIFO before rejecting its type
requirements.origin: New file/role flags introduced by 3d3e4b4d9d2; later kind checking remains after open.
requirements.fix: Open non-directory artifacts with O_NONBLOCK and O_NOCTTY, then reject non-regular descriptors before reading. Preserve strict resolution and descriptor identity; a path stat before open is insufficient.

requirements.title: Mobile replay-store custody never checks Darwin ACL authority
requirements.origin: Introduced by c85ef77b08d in the new durable mobile challenge store.
requirements.fix: Check retained parent and database descriptors for authority-granting Darwin ACLs during initial and subsequent custody validation. Reuse the existing descriptor inspection boundary and fail closed on inspection errors; do not add another FFI implementation.

requirements.title: Simulation rejects valid repeated effects against one captured target
requirements.origin: Introduced in the new simulation loop by 5920a896c7c.
requirements.fix: Validate each effect's base against the immutable captured state, then apply ordered contributions to the working copy. Alternatively explicitly forbid the combination consistently in validation/builders/schema if it is unsupported.

requirements.title: Go manifest validation copies oversized fields before its size refusal
requirements.origin: Introduced by 348b7ae4c22 in the new manifest preflight decoder.
requirements.fix: Apply the shared input size limit before constructing the manifest decoder or copying a property. Keep presence, duplicate and semantic validation.

requirements.title: Anthropic gate returns unevaluated tool content in message_start as safe
requirements.origin: Pre-existing in main 2b1d467e17; retained in the PR-revised lifetime gate (6ef28e8f4d). Not an introduced execution bypass.
requirements.fix: Refuse populated initial tool content, or route every allowed initial content item through the same evaluation state machine before release. Keep the existing provider-lifecycle checks.

requirements.title: The Start convenience command drops the accepted current authority pin
requirements.origin: The global pin was introduced by c336ce08385. Current API Protect wiring was repaired by 4fd87c47794; the Start alias still retains the old environment-only selection.
requirements.fix: Pass the current authority pin through Start and use the same issuer-list construction as its API Protect counterpart. Test the actual command-to-config boundary, not only the helper.

requirements.title: Two tamper tests cannot detect removal of reflected-decision validation
requirements.origin: Both test files and their fixtures are introduced by 9e9b3be5f61.
requirements.fix: Use tampered otherwise-allowing replies and assert the precise integrity/reflected-binding refusal at the real adapter. Preserve healthy allow and legitimate deny controls. No new harness is needed.

requirements.title: Interrupted decoy creation leaves a final file that exact retry cannot recover
requirements.origin: Introduced by 6ea79bb5dab in the new materializer/registry.
requirements.fix: Complete content and ownership metadata in a private same-parent staging object, fsync, then publish with no-replace semantics and sync the parent. Define bounded staging recovery without deleting an unproven final object.

requirements.title: Portable issuer fetch excludes DNS from its total deadline
requirements.origin: Introduced by 08de2d8bd27, the new bounded portable issuer/lifecycle fetch implementation.
requirements.fix: Start one enforceable budget before DNS and carry remaining time into HTTP, using resolution whose lifetime is bounded. Keep checked-address pinning. Merely timing out the await does not reclaim the worker/permit.

requirements.title: Candidate copy bounds ignore Git tree metadata and empty-file count
requirements.origin: Introduced by 8be503269ea in the new host runner.
requirements.fix: Bound tree-output bytes, entry count and aggregate path metadata before retaining/materializing them. Preserve the existing per-blob and total-content limits. Use the existing runner boundary rather than new qualification tooling.

requirements.title: A completed channel cannot accept its next valid service reservation
requirements.origin: Pre-existing in changed files. Both version==1 fences blame to 51e46336b1f, an ancestor of base; PR parser/diagnostic changes do not introduce them.
requirements.fix: Fence against the observed monotonic lifecycle version in the existing transaction and publication path, preserving exact channel/reservation/snapshot checks. Do not reset the counter or weaken the fence.

requirements.title: Zero-share verifier children have no retained identity bound
requirements.origin: Pre-existing in changed code: VerifyOnly insertion/retention is from 818d1c5c94a. This PR's 916e5d8364c adds checked arithmetic, not the missing identity bound.
requirements.fix: Apply finite per-parent entry and retained-identity byte limits before new insertion, preserving idempotent existing-child checks and live holders. A cached sum improves work but does not bound memory. Reject zero-share authority only if that is the intended schema contract.

requirements.title: Mobile gating exposes a plain Allow for requirements it cannot enforce
requirements.origin: Pre-existing mobile projection from 00b6eb15658 and inherited ordinary-grant omissions, retained in PR-changed evaluator/mobile files.
requirements.fix: Expose a clearly non-authoritative portable outcome and require mediated authorization for unsupported requirements, or refuse those matched grants in the mobile gate. Align the offline guide. Avoid a compatibility alias that preserves ambiguous Allow.

requirements.title: RegistryUpdateError stops traversal of retained native causes
requirements.origin: Introduced by f83f1fef0b4; the outer source-bearing wrapper is from 66bc596efe2.
requirements.fix: Implement source for the three wrapped-error variants using the retained error; no new error abstraction.
